name: Document360
tagline: Document360 is a SaaS knowledge base platform that helps companies create, manage, and publish product documentation, FAQs, and user manuals. Its AI features include semantic search, auto-tagging, content suggestions, and an AI chatbot that answers user questions from the knowledge base.
